huntTickets.description: Event ticketing app. 30K+ tickets processed, 4.3★ App Store rating, 5K+ downloads in first year.
huntTickets.impactLine: Mobile ticketing for Colombia's event industry. 30K+ tickets in year one.
huntTickets.problem: Colombia's live event industry had no reliable mobile ticketing infrastructure. Buyers paid in cash or bank transfers. Organizers had no real-time inventory visibility, no digital validation, and no data on who attended their events.
huntTickets.solution: We built a native mobile app from scratch — real-time seat inventory, QR-based entry validation, and integrated payment processing with local and international methods. The system was designed to handle high-concurrency ticket drops without failing under load.
huntTickets.result: 30K+ tickets sold. 4.3★ App Store rating. 5K+ downloads in the first year. Hunt became the default ticketing system for multiple venues across Colombia.

faq.label: Working with us
faq.title: Clear answers, no sales pitch.
faq.supporting: Everything you need to know before starting a project with Dreeeams. Process, timelines, investment, and what to expect.

q1.question: What kind of projects do you take on?
q1.answer:
We work with companies that need real digital systems — not just a visual refresh.
That means: web platforms, product sites with business goals, mobile apps, backend infrastructure, integrations, and AI automation workflows.
If the build needs to be strategic, scalable, and well-executed, we're a good fit.

q2.question: What does a project typically cost?
q2.answer:
It depends on scope.
Targeted builds — a landing system, a specific integration — sit at one end. Full product builds, mobile apps, and AI/automation systems require more investment.
We define scope first, then recommend the right budget range. No surprises.

q3.question: How long does a project take?
q3.answer:
A focused website or landing system: 4–6 weeks. A mobile app or complex platform: 3–6 months.
We scope the timeline during our first call based on your goals and technical requirements.

q4.question: What do you need from us to start?
q4.answer:
Clarity on your goal.
The problem you want to solve, the product you want to launch, or the system you want to improve.
You don't need perfect documentation. But the clearer your objective, the faster we scope and execute.

q5.question: Can you work with our existing team or product?
q5.answer:
Yes. We work as an independent build partner or alongside your internal team — designers, developers, or product leads.
We also take over existing products when the current setup needs redesign, refactoring, or stronger technical execution.

q6.question: Do you support the product after launch?
q6.answer:
Yes. Most projects continue after launch — improvements, new features, technical support, performance tuning, and product iteration.
We build systems that evolve. We don't ship once and disappear.
